verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own capability for this story. Devboxes are isolated Linux sandboxes. Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs without ever seeing the API keys, and MCP Hub gives agents tool access without exposing credentials. Account secrets are injected as environment variables only when you opt in. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation boundary (that host or account credentials are unreachable by default from code running in a Devbox), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the gateways actually keep keys hidden.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can give an agent a sandbox where host secrets and credentials are unreachable by the code it runs

citations.quote: Runloop is the best platform for running isolated Linux sandbox environments (Devboxes) for AI coding agent
Agent Gateways let your agents call LLM APIs like Anthropic and OpenAI **without ever seeing your API keys**.
Give your agents access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials
Runloop provides secure sandboxed execution environments called Devboxes.
